relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Li et al. (2019) reported that bath application of calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) can recruit silent responses in the ACC of adult mice

relationships.subject: BDNF
relationships.evidence_quote: By bath application of BDNF, Miao et al. (2021) reported in the ACC that BDNF recruits silent responses

relationships.subject: GluA1
relationships.evidence_quote: found that the recruitment of silent responses was blocked in GluA1 845 knock-in mice, indicating that GluA1 is required for such recruitment

relationships.subject: CaMKII
relationships.evidence_quote: it is shown that postsynaptic CaMKII plays critical roles in triggering the recruitment of silent synapses

relationships.subject: AC1
relationships.evidence_quote: Genetic and pharmacological findings indicate that AC1 or AC1 activity is required for the recruitment of silent responses in the ACC

key_findings: Review: silent synapses (filopodia) exist in adult ACC and are recruited by LTP, CGRP and BDNF.
Recruitment depends on NMDA receptor, AC1, PKA and GluA1 Ser845 signaling.
